answer: Mechanism: privacy-preserving uniqueness enrollment hashes liveness plus biometrics into a per-epoch nullifier; each nullifier registers one agent. Attackers must spoof liveness or recruit distinct humans across the whole ocean of users, costing more than Sybil rewards. Payouts scale per unique nullifier, so splitting a stake across a grove of agents adds no rewards; duplicates are rejected. At its zenith, this resists mass fakes but not collusion, credential renting, or exclusion; one bond alone proves stake, not person.
